M3-05.title: Complete settings and notification controls
M3-05.source_acceptance: Text scale, number notation, motion/audio controls, input navigation and opt-in quiet-hour notifications function across targets.
M3-05.adaptation: Preserve original acceptance; AI writes, runs and reviews the implementation. External evidence remains required where specified.
M3-05.evidence_note: Local implementation and separately pinned author/independent evidence. Original acceptance and dependencies remain intact; physical/native/provider/human/elapsed observation gates remain open where unmet.

S26.requirement: Settings, target input, readable numbers, contextual help and opt-in quiet-hour notifications
S26.verification: Large text/reduced motion/non-color cues and critical controls work on named targets.

blueprint_line309: Use an account-day boundary chosen at onboarding, with a fixed UTC offset for the baseline; changing time zones never grants another day's rewards. Day identifiers, queue states and claim receipts survive Rechart. Notifications are opt-in, can be bundled, and respect quiet hours.
